purpose: Inspect only the taxonomy/tag/member names of chronology-safe pre-anchor NSE shareholding XBRLs to determine whether the already-approved MF, FII and institutional-breadth concepts are explicitly represented. No holding values or future outcomes may be exposed.
decision_rule: Proceed to a separate preregistered numeric replay only if MF/FII/institutional categories are explicitly identifiable in the XBRL taxonomy and can be mapped without semantic inference from ambiguous labels.
